meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 它把已解析的文档和你的查询目标转成四张卡片：蓝色事实卡（附来源片段）、绿色解释卡、黄色风险卡、红色行动卡，每张卡都留痕可溯源。
howto.when: 当手上已有解析后的结构化文档和明确查询目标、需要产出可审计卡片时接管；由通政司 Worker 主调用，也可分 extract、review、propose 三阶段运行。

say.text: 把这份解析后的文档做成四色卡片
say.note: 产出蓝、绿、黄、红四张卡片

say.text: 先跑 extract 阶段，生成事实蓝卡
say.note: 由通政司 Worker 抽取事实

say.text: 黄卡帮我标出过度声明和不确定性

howto.what_en: It turns a parsed document plus your query goal into four cards: blue fact card (with source snippets), green explanation card, yellow risk card, and red action card; each card is traced and auditable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you already have a parsed structured document and a clear query goal and need auditable cards; mainly invoked by the Tongzhengsi Worker.

say_en.text: Turn this parsed document into four-color cards
say_en.note: Produces blue, green, yellow, red cards

say_en.text: Run the extract stage to build the fact card
Use the yellow card to flag over-claims and uncertainty
say_en.note: Yellow card is checked by Jianchayuan
